calculation.description: Cross-sectional 10-session residual reversal, scaled by the prevailing cross-sectional return dispersion relative to its 40-session baseline, smoothed over three observations and lagged one completed session to avoid look-ahead. Higher values indicate stronger expected forward returns.

validation.regime_notes: Full-history daily cross-sectional validation on all 15 tradable benchmark instruments; minimum 8 valid instruments per date. H5 IC/ICIR 0.030029/0.098466 and H10 0.032841/0.113834 also passed gates. H20 recent 365/730/1095-observation IC/ICIR: 0.019451/0.062439, 0.038761/0.134982, 0.035938/0.124731; short recent drift is weaker but longer windows remain positive.
validation.provenance: Signals are reproducible from the listed script and ../persistent/stock_data/*.csv through cutoff 2031-11-12; no future data used. Pairwise library correlation not computed in this cycle.
